positions.title: Mutual IP indemnity
positions.preferredLanguage: Each party shall indemnify the other against third-party claims alleging infringement of intellectual property rights by the indemnifying party's deliverables, subject to standard exclusions.
positions.fallbackLanguage: Vendor shall indemnify Customer for third-party IP claims arising from the Service as provided; Customer shall indemnify Vendor for claims arising from Customer Content.

positions.title: General liability cap
positions.preferredLanguage: Aggregate liability capped at twelve (12) months of fees immediately preceding the claim.
positions.fallbackLanguage: Aggregate liability capped at twelve (12) months of fees; breaches of confidentiality capped at two times (2×) annual fees.

positions.title: Uncapped carve-outs
positions.preferredLanguage: Carve-outs from limitation of liability: indemnification, confidentiality, data breach, gross negligence, willful misconduct, and payment obligations.
positions.fallbackLanguage: Same carve-outs except data breach limited to 2× annual fees super-cap.

positions.title: Order Form vs MSA hierarchy
positions.preferredLanguage: Order Form terms supplement the MSA; on conflict, MSA governs except where Order Form expressly states a higher standard of care or liability.
positions.fallbackLanguage: On conflict, greater protection for Customer applies; liability is the greater of MSA and Order Form caps.

comparisons.deviationSummary: Vendor-only indemnity; missing Customer IP indemnity for Customer Content.
Order Form reduces liability below MSA without greater-of construct.
